card.name: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant drug text
card.fires_on: Words and word parts in antithrombotic drug labels (clopidogrel, prasugrel, apixaban, tirofiban), just before platelet or clotting terms or inside drug names. It fires on small linking marks like a comma, bracket, "of" or "to" and on partial words like "ogenous" and "plate".
